name: Kahuzi-Biega National Park
description: Kahuzi-Biega National Park protects a vast stretch of rainforest in eastern Congo, near the city of Bukavu and the western shore of Lake Kivu. Two extinct volcanoes, Kahuzi and Biega, rise above the trees. The park is best known as a refuge for eastern lowland gorillas, one of the last groups of its kind, living high on the slopes. It is listed as World Heritage in Danger.
